         <rs type="work">dho ha mdzod kyi sgo dbye ba'i sgron ma lhan cig skyes pa'i snang ba</rs> zhes bya ba | <lb n="22b7"/> <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:3854">dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa blo gros seng ge</rs>s sbyar pa | rdzogs s+ho ||
         <note type="translation">The light of co-emergence, the lamp that opens the door of the treasure of doha.</note></seg></TEI>
